content.text:
Fixed. The findings all had one cause: the reference query runs over the `calendar_list_entries` storage rows, whose ids are `cle_` + calendar id (the private storage ids the model notes), while the API-facing id stays the calendar id. I changed:

- `reference.target`: `apac@northwind.example` → `cle_apac@northwind.example`
- The four decoy `witness` ids → `cle_apac-notes@…`, `cle_apac-team@…`, `cle_apac-team-old@…`, `cle_apac-team-2017@…`

Nothing else changed: the seed still seeds by calendar id, the `write` path keeps the API-facing calendar id (`PATCH /users/me/calendarList/apac@northwind.example`), and the `REPLACE` mutations still join `calendar_list_entries.calendar_id` → `calendars.id`, where the calendar ids are unchanged. With the witness ids now pointing at real rows, each mutated query (DROP f_role / edge-to-`calendars.summary` / substring / DROP f_vis) selects its witness while the original query selects only the target.
